assumptions.reason: Commits full available capital while reserving a 0.1% buffer for broker commission to prevent order rejection due to insufficient margin.

assumptions.choice: Evaluate the 2% price drop/rise condition using self.data.close[0]
assumptions.reason: Specification states 'price drops/rises by 2% from the entry price' without specifying intrabar high/low breach checks, so standard bar close is evaluated.

assumptions.choice: Require self.position.size == 0 before opening a new long or short position
assumptions.reason: Aligns with Canonical Default #3 (hold at most one position at a time) and the specification clause 'provided no existing long/short position is held'.
